question: Will Arda Güler assist in Racing Santander vs Real Madrid on Nov 1, 2026 (15:15 UTC, 90 min only)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes, at least one assist": Wins if Arda Güler is credited with at least one assist in the Racing Santander vs Real Madrid match played on 2026-11-01, strictly after 2026-11-01T09:35:42.964Z and at or before 2026-11-02T00:15:00.000Z, counting only actions occurring within the first 90 minutes of regulation (minutes 1–90, excluding any extra time, penalty shootout, or added stoppage time beyond the 90th minute).
- "No assist": Wins if Arda Güler is credited with zero assists under the same conditions, including if he did not appear in the match.

Clarifications:
- An assist is defined as the final pass or action directly leading to a goal scored by a teammate within regulation minutes 1–90; assists on goals scored in stoppage time beyond the 90th minute or in extra time do not count.
